description:
This file defines the AWS Lightsail client class, including method annotations for various Lightsail API operations, enabling interaction with the Amazon Lightsail service.
It extends a generic AWS client class and provides method signatures and documentation for external API calls.

classes.name: LightsailClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with Amazon Lightsail API, providing methods for various resources and actions supported by the service.

methods.name: allocateStaticIp
methods.description: Allocates a static IP in Lightsail.

methods.name: attachCertificateToDistribution
methods.description: Attaches a certificate to a distribution.

methods.name: attachDisk
methods.description: Attaches an disk to an instance.
